test_title: RRB NTPC - Graduate 2025 (CBT 1) Foundational Full Test - 01
subject: general
question:
Two statements are given, followed by two conclusions numbered I, and II. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

A. All foals are fin.

B. All fins are car.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some cars are fin.

II. Some fins are foals.

options.text: Both conclusion I and conclusion II follow.
Neither conclusion I nor conclusion II follows.

solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements will be:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7c9b02bef2b6b6088fa20ffdc130df7973790dc56bc6b4bcd84c851da8d0eaeb.png] 

**Conclusions:**

I. Some cars are fin → True( As all fin are cars, some cars are definitely fin)

II. Some fins are foals → True( As all foals are fins, some fins are definitely foals).

Hence, both conclusion **I **and conclusion **II** follow.
